items.text: The world’s largest private residence is in India… and it’s not Mukesh Ambani’s Antilia
items.article: While Antilia is among the world’s largest and most luxurious private homes, the top spot belongs to a heritage residence in Vadodara. | Trending Talk about the world’s largest private residence and most Indians will immediately think of Antilia — industrialist Mukesh Ambani’s towering abode in Mumbai. That, however, would be incorrect. While Antilia is among the world’s largest and most luxurious private homes, the top spot belongs to a heritage residence in Vadodara. The Laxmi Vilas Palace is actually the world’s largest private residence, and it dwarfs modern-day palatial residences like Antilia as well as iconic symbols like the British royal family’s Buckingham Palace. The Laxmi Vilas Palace, seat of the Gaekwad royal family of Baroda, sits on a 500-acre compound that also houses a 10-hole golf course, a cricket stadium, an ancient stepwell and multiple gardens. Located in Gujarat’s Vadodara, the palace itself has over 170 rooms and three courtyards, along with an armory (shastra ghar), a badminton court, a tennis court and the royal darbar where Prime Minister Narendra Modi hosted Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez in 2024. A post shared by Priyam Saraswat (@priyamsaraswat) The palace complex encompasses the Gaekwad Baroda Golf Club, the Moti Bagh Cricket Stadium, the Maharaja Fateh Singh Museum building and the offices of the Baroda Cricket Association, according to Lifestyle Asia. One part of that process gets simpler from today. A resident individual or Hindu undivided family (HUF) buying immovable property from an NRI will no longer need a TAN or tax account number just to deduct tax at source on the transaction. Now, the buyer can use PAN and deposit the tax deducted at source (TDS) through Form 141. The form will have a new Schedule E for such transactions. “Form 141 is not a new form introduced by this notification. It is a consolidated challan-cum-statement that was introduced under the new Income-Tax Act, 2025, for specific TDS transactions. It is already used for depositing TDS on payments by individuals and HUFs to residents, including TDS on purchase of immovable property from a resident. Delayed implantation is found in some other armadillo species, showing how remarkably flexible reproduction can be among these mammals. According to the government, UPI is live in countries including the UAE, Singapore, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, France, Mauritius and Qatar.
